title: In the Name of the Law
paragraphs: A police true-crime dramatization based on actual case files, reconstructing investigations of crimes ranging from theft to murder.

1936 syndicated police-case anthology claiming to dramatize actual crime files. Frozen GRH set contains eight historical broadcasts plus a 2019 Old Time Radio Researchers introduction; collector chronologies disagree on several dates and program numbers.
GRH documents the program through 1936 syndicated run (1936 to 1936).
Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Ken Christy (performer on 2 recordings).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include true crime and police case files, police investigation and detection, 1930s syndicated radio, homicide investigation, prison escape and manhunt, and narcotics smuggling.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Fragmentary and disputed collector chronology and 1930s syndicated true-crime police anthology.
